threeCriticalFindings.title: Late-Stage Competitor Discounting on Big Deals
threeCriticalFindings.summary: Competitors like Gong and Clari are offering 20%+ discounts bundled with European data storage on deals above ₹200,000.
threeCriticalFindings.evidenceSource: Call #REV-8821 with Dr. Elena Weber (Acme Cloud Europe)
threeCriticalFindings.transcriptQuote: Gong is packaging conversation intelligence with forecast rollups at a 22% lower seat price... If your VP of Sales can approve matching within 10% and give us the London datacenter SLA in writing, I can approve signature.
threeCriticalFindings.actionTaken: Manager flagged call for attention, authorized 12% price adjustment, and prepared European data guarantee.

threeCriticalFindings.title: Reps Talking Too Much and Ignoring Shift-Worker Pricing
threeCriticalFindings.summary: Mid-market prospects with shift staff need shared user pools, but reps talked for 76% of the meeting presenting standard slide decks instead of listening.
threeCriticalFindings.transcriptQuote: Our nurses and coordinators work staggered shifts. Can 3 shift workers share one pool license, or do we have to pay ₹8,500 per individual name?
threeCriticalFindings.actionTaken: Manager flagged rep coaching alert for talking 76% of call and created a task to send pooled license terms.

threeCriticalFindings.title: Unanswered Security and Data Key Demands Delaying Deals
threeCriticalFindings.summary: Large enterprise deals stall in procurement when customer security questions sit without answers.
threeCriticalFindings.evidenceSource: Call #REV-8819 with Marcus Vance (CloudScale Bank, ₹380,000 deal)
threeCriticalFindings.transcriptQuote: Under banking regulations, we cannot accept third-party voice storage without dedicated KMS encryption keys... Either that is included in the ₹380,000 proposal, or we pause the deal right here.
threeCriticalFindings.actionTaken: Manager assigned high-priority security review task to David Vance with a 48-hour deadline.

difficultRoutingDecision.conflict: Sarah Lin manages the US corporate parent account. David Vance manages the UK/Europe branch where the budget was actually spent.
difficultRoutingDecision.chosenResolution: Dual Split Attribution: 60% credit to David Vance for local execution, 40% credit to Sarah Lin for global master agreement coverage.
difficultRoutingDecision.whyChosen: Kept both reps motivated, avoided internal conflict, and sped up the deal by 14 days.

duplicateImportTest.result: Zero duplicate records created. Manager notes were safely preserved while updated amounts and talk times were merged.

decisionConsideredAndRejected.decision: Fully automatic AI updating into Salesforce without manager review
decisionConsideredAndRejected.whyConsidered: Would instantly update deal stages and reps without waiting for human input.
decisionConsideredAndRejected.whyRejected: During testing, the AI made mistakes on 18% of complex parent/subsidiary companies, wrongly reassigning commission to the wrong rep. Revenue attribution must stay human-verified for difficult cases.
